subject: Science
description: Beads on a string: DNA wound around histone protein cores, joined by linker DNA
alt: A row of four nucleosomes: DNA wound twice around each histone protein core, with short linker DNA between them
prompt: Four identical nucleosomes in a horizontal row, like beads on a string. Each is a histone core (a cluster of rounded lobes in a warm tone) with a strand of DNA wound about twice around it, and short linker DNA joining each to the next. All four cores are drawn exactly the same; only one thing is orange: the histone cores (all four).
checklist: four nucleosomes, all four drawn identically, including the colour of the histone core
DNA is wound around each core about two turns and continues as linker DNA between cores
the DNA strand is continuous from the first to the last nucleosome
